title: Unit 12: English-speaking Countries
source: Tiếng Anh 7 - Global Success - Sách bài tập, trang 92-98

exercises.instruction: Lan and Linda are talking about Linda's visit to the Hobbit Village in New Zealand. Rearrange the sentences to make a complete conversation. Then practise it with a friend.

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.line: Hi Linda, how was your visit to the Hobbit Village?

dialogue.speaker: Linda
dialogue.line: It was fantastic! I had a very good time there.

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.line: Tell me what it was like.

dialogue.speaker: Linda
dialogue.line: I saw the real setting where they made the hobbit movies: old-style houses, the farms, the inn …

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.line: Could you actually enter the houses?

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.line: Did you do anything on the farm?

dialogue.speaker: Linda
dialogue.line: I took pictures of the green pastures. They were beautiful, especially at sunset. I also fed some baby lambs.

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.line: I'd love to feed them too. I'll visit the Hobbit Village one day.

exercises.instruction: Read the passage "The Albuquerque Balloon Festival" and write short answers to the questions.
exercises.passage:
THE ALBUQUERQUE BALLOON FESTIVAL
The Albuquerque International Hot-air Balloon Festival is the largest gathering of hot-air balloons in the world. The festival is a nine-day event in early October. It takes place in Albuquerque, a city in New Mexico, the USA. Every year, the festival attracts a great number of balloon makers. They bring about five hundred balloons to the festival. Many artists spend weeks or even months painting their balloons. Together with them are thousands of photographers, video makers, reporters, and visitors. The most exciting moment of the festival is when all the balloons in different shapes, sizes, and colours rise up high into the sky. The scene is really fantastic.
The Balloon Festival is one of Albuquerque's largest tourist attractions. It is an opportunity for the local people to show their New Mexican culture and history. It brings a major source of income to the city and local businesses. In 2015, the festival received nearly one million visitors.

questions.stem: Where does the festival take place?
questions.answer: In Albuquerque, a city in New Mexico, the USA.

questions.stem: How long does it last?
What do the artists do before the festival?
Who goes to the festival?
questions.answer: Balloon makers, photographers, video makers, reporters, and visitors.

questions.stem: What does the festival help New Mexico show its visitors?
What does the festival bring to the city?

exercises.note: Đây là bài trả lời câu hỏi ngắn (short answer), không phải T/F/NI — dùng type true_false_no_info tạm để tái sử dụng UI hiện có không phù hợp hoàn toàn; cần UI dạng 'answer-only' riêng cho câu hỏi đọc hiểu ngắn.

exercises.instruction: Read and complete the passage "Disneyland" with the words in the box.
exercises.passage_template:
California is (1) ____ to one of the biggest and most famous entertainment parks in the world – Disneyland. Disneyland opened in 1955 with the slogan "The happiest place on (2) ____", and it soon became very popular. The number of visitors to the park has gone up very (3) ____.
In 2018, it attracted nearly 19 million visitors, both (4) ____ and adults.
There are different kinds of entertainment throughout the park. Mickey's Soundsational Parade is (5) ____ most popular event. It celebrates songs from the most famous Disney films. During the parade, well-known Disney characters march along Main Street. (6) ____ dance along with the music, greet visitors, talk with children, and pose for photos. Everybody is (7) ____ to join in the fun.
Another great attraction of the park is its fantastic fireworks (8) ____. During the busy season, the park offers the show nightly.

exercises.instruction: Read the passage and complete the summary in the box with the information from the passage.
exercises.passage:
The ability to use English brings a lot of benefits to its users. It helps you learn many things by watching TV programmes and YouTube videos. It helps you communicate when you are travelling abroad. It also allows you to sing English songs, read English books, and make friends from many English-speaking countries.
In Asia alone, there are countries where English is a second, or official, language. It means people in these countries use English at schools, at work, and for public communication. These countries include India, Singapore, Nepal, the Philippines, and Pakistan. This means that if you know English, you can communicate when you visit these countries.
exercises.passage_template:
English users have a lot of (1) ____.
Name two benefits of knowing English:
– communicate when travelling
– (2) ____
– (3) ____
The word "second" in "second language" is similar to (4) ____.
Name two countries where English is a second language:
– (5) ____
– (6) ____

answers.2: sing English songs / read English books / make friends from English-speaking countries (any two)
answers.3: sing English songs / read English books / make friends from English-speaking countries (any two)
answers.5: India / Singapore / Nepal / the Philippines / Pakistan (any two)
answers.6: India / Singapore / Nepal / the Philippines / Pakistan (any two)

exercises.instruction: Based on the information below, write a paragraph of about 70 words to introduce Canada.
word_web_prompts: Famous for: beautiful landscape, a rich culture and many places of interests
Places to visit: Heritage Park, Historical Landmark Tour of Victorian Grand City, Museum of Illusions, Canadian Museum of History …
exercises.suggested_answer: Canada is a big country in North America. The country has a population of over 35 million. Its capital city is Ottawa. Canada has many things to offer visitors: beautiful landscape, a rich culture and many places of interests. You can visit Heritage Park, Historical Landmark Tour of Victorian Grand City, Museum of Illusions, Canadian Museum of History … The weather in Canada is 25°C to 30°C in summer and it is very harsh in winter. The temperature sometimes drops to -40°C.
